title: Plans to Set Up More ServiceSG Centres across Singapore
what_it_is: Plans to Set Up More ServiceSG Centres across Singapore

sections.label: ServiceSG centres and expansion
sections.summary: ServiceSG has set up seven centres since 2021, offers almost 600 services with over 25 agencies, and will add two centres by end-2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Since its inception in 2021, ServiceSG has set up seven centres.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: These centres are strategically located at Our Tampines Hub, One Punggol, Bukit Canberra, Kampong Chai Chee Community Club, Nee Soon Central Community Club, The Frontier Community Club and Keat Hong Community Club.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The ServiceSG Centres have also expanded their service offerings in partnership with more than 25 agencies, providing almost 600 services to citizens.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: In line with this, two new centres will be established at Woodlands Civic Centre and Bukit Merah town central by the end of 2024.

sections.label: Seniors walk-in ServiceSG Centres
sections.summary: Seniors can walk into ServiceSG Centres without a prior appointment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Seniors can also walk into ServiceSG Centres and no prior appointment is needed.

sections.label: Multilingual ambassadors and service integration
sections.summary: Multilingual-abled service ambassadors will be increased, and service delivery across agencies will be rationalised, integrated and synergised to save resources and manpower.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Second, yes, we will increase the number of multilingual-abled service ambassadors to the extent that we can.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Third, indeed, we do not want to duplicate services and we want to rationalise, integrate and synergise the service delivery across the various agencies in order to save resources and manpower.
